generation.explanation: This is the classic geometric proof of the geometric series 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 + ⋯ = 1. Start with a unit square: fill half of it (1/2), then half of what remains (1/4), then half of that remainder (1/8), and so on. After n steps the filled area is 1 − 1/2ⁿ and the empty gap is exactly 1/2ⁿ, which shrinks toward 0 as n grows — so the pieces must fill the entire square, meaning the infinite sum equals 1. Use the slider to show n terms, or replay the filling animation and watch the gap spiral into the corner and vanish.
